name: Daisy
medications: Carprofen 50mg - one tablet with evening meal

routine.morning: 7:00 AM - Breakfast (1.5 cups dry food) + 30min walk in park

preferences: Daisy responds to 'good girl' and her favorite toy is the blue rope. She's anxious around loud noises — speak calmly and move slowly. Sleeps on her bed in living room, left corner.

name: Whiskers

routine.morning: 8:00 AM - Wet food (1 pouch) + fresh water

preferences: Whiskers is indoor-only. Hides under bed when scared. Litter box in bathroom. Loves chin scratches.

name: Luna

routine.morning: 7:30 AM - Breakfast (1 cup dry food) + short walk (10min)
routine.evening: 6:30 PM - Dinner (1 cup dry food) + short walk (10min)

preferences: Luna can't handle heat or strenuous exercise. Keep indoors during hot days. She snores loudly when sleeping.

name: Milo

routine.morning: 7:00 AM - Dry food (1/2 cup) + water refill
routine.evening: 6:00 PM - Wet food (1 pouch) + playtime with feather toy

preferences: Milo is very playful and gets along with Daisy. Loves to climb - has a cat tree in bedroom.
